🔎 What We're Looking For

Job title: Principal Statistician

Location: Siena, Italy

Employment type: Permanent, Full-Time

Closing date for applications: 23 August 2026

Scope:

Provide stat expertise to support the different study designs.

Responsibilities

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

Responsible for a whole study from design to execution for different study designs:

  • Use stat methodology to establish study strategy (e.g.power modelling of different scenarios, set up power monitoring, set up mitigation plan to minimize risk of stat failure)

  • Provide input to protocol (design, objective, endpoint, randomization strategy, sample size, stat analysis)

  • Provide input to study set up (CRF review, randomization, DMP plan including specification for subset, important protocol deviation)

  • Lead or contribute to Quantitative Decision Making activities, including development of Probability of Success assessments, simulation-based evaluations, scenario analyses and other quantitative approaches that support project, governance and portfolio decisions

  • Develop SAP/AAR (involving sensitivity analysis to support robustness of result) and coordinate review

  • Review the TFL, to coordinate review with the stat analyst, to approve the TFL

  • Do the QC of the statistical analysis methodology

  • Validate study specific dataset & analysis pgm specification

  • Approve deviation from TFL format

  • Propose SAR conclusion

  • Prepare answer to study specific stat question (e.g. inspection, RA question)

  • Provide stat support to an independent analysis center

  • Provide consultancy on stat matter for other statisticians

Why you?

Basic Qualifications & Skills

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

  • Master Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Epidemiology or equivalent, withat least 5-year experience in the pharmaceutical industry;
    OR PhD in Statistics, Mathematics or Epidemiology or equivalentwith at least 2-year experience in the pharmaceutical industry.

  • Experience in Statistical software (R preferred) and sample size computation for standard designs.

  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary team (e.g. give guidance to non-stat, provide feedback, engage), some being remotely located.

  • Fluent level of English, both written and spoken. Italian language skills are preferred

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

  • Has been previously responsible for studies with different designs (dose range, superiority/non inferiority, futility rule,..)

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex statistical topics clearly

  • Ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams

  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to handle complex situations

  • Leadership and influencing skills, including the ability to guide and mentor others

  • Attention to detail and strong quality focus

  • Adaptability in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As we expand our Enterprise business, we are looking for an experienced Solutions Architecture Manager, Enterprise to lead our customer-facing Solutions Architecture organization for the Enterprise segment.
This is a leadership role at the intersection of technology, enterprise strategy and business value. You will build and lead a high-performing team of Solutions Architects, partner closely with Enterprise Sales leadership, and engage directly with senior technology and business executives at some of our most strategic customers. The scope of the role reflects where the business is today; as we scale, we expect the organization to specialize and subdivide, and this leader will help shape and staff that evolution.

You’re welcome to work remotely in the United States.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build, lead and coach a high-performing team of Enterprise Solutions Architects.
  • Own the technical engagement model for the Enterprise segment in close partnership with Enterprise Sales leadership in your region, including how coverage and ownership are divided as the team expands
  • Set clear priorities, operating mechanisms and performance expectations for the Enterprise Solutions Architecture team.
  • Engage directly with CIOs, CTOs, Heads of Infrastructure, Heads of AI/ML, Business leaders and other senior stakeholders.
  • Champion the voice of Enterprise customers internally, provide guidance for Nebius's Product and Technology roadmap in Enterprise Readiness.
  • Establish a strong culture focused on customer outcomes, technical excellence, business value and commercial impact.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of experience in people-management, including hiring, coaching and developing senior technical professionals.
  • 5+ years of experience working with Enterprise companies, with a deep understanding of how large organizations evaluate, purchase, adopt and expand strategic technology platforms.
  • Proven experience in value engineering for Enterprise customers — translating technology investments and complex architectures into measurable business outcomes, economic value and compelling business cases. Ability to operate effectively across both the technical and business dimensions of complex Enterprise engagements and influence C-level and senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent executive communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing environment where team structures, coverage boundaries and scope of ownership will continue to evolve

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Strong understanding of cloud-native infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, security and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with GPU-based infrastructure workloads, accelerated computing.
  • Experience designing or supporting machine learning and AI workloads, including training and inference.
  • Understanding of distributed AI/ML infrastructure and the compute, networking and storage considerations associated with large-scale GPU workloads.
  • Experience with Kubernetes-based AI/ML platforms, MLOps or AI infrastructure.
  • Experience helping Enterprise customers evaluate the economics of large-scale compute or GPU workloads.

Key employee benefits in the US:

  • Health insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.
  • 401(k) plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.
  • Parental leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.
  • Remote work reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.
  • Disability & life insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range
$195,825—$244,725 USD

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Business Operations Coordinator to manage the day-to-day operational execution of the business across CRM management, billing and invoicing, scheduling, client communication, data management, and administrative workflows.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role, not a strategy or leadership position.

You’ll be responsible for keeping operational systems accurate, invoices moving, schedules organized, records up to date, and client follow-ups on track.

If you’re highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working across multiple systems, and enjoy making sure nothing falls through the cracks, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

CRM & Data Management – Critical

  • Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date CRM records
  • Manage operational data across:
    • Excel / Google Sheets
    • OneDrive
    • CompanyCam
    • CRM systems
  • Ensure information remains consistent across systems
  • Identify and correct discrepancies before they create billing or reporting issues
  • Maintain organized digital records and documentation
  • Keep pipelines current with no stale records or missed follow-ups

Billing, Invoicing & Accounts Receivable

  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and on time
  • Ensure billing aligns with completed work and operational records
  • Track outstanding balances and payment statuses
  • Follow up on accounts receivable when needed
  • Coordinate with accounting on reconciliations and supporting documentation
  • Maintain accurate and organized billing records
  • Identify discrepancies and resolve or escalate them promptly

Scheduling & Job Tracking

  • Coordinate crew and job schedules using systems such as Aspire and Azuga
  • Monitor active jobs, schedules, and operational workflows
  • Identify scheduling conflicts, job delays, and time discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate time-tracking records
  • Support accurate data for:
    • Payroll processing
    • Job costing
    • Operational reporting
  • Communicate scheduling changes to the appropriate stakeholders

Client & Lead Coordination

  • Manage inbound client inquiries and routine communication
  • Track leads, clients, and follow-up activity within the CRM
  • Ensure inquiries receive timely responses
  • Coordinate follow-ups so opportunities and client requests aren’t missed
  • Maintain clear notes and communication history
  • Escalate urgent client matters appropriately

Reporting, Documentation & Research

  • Prepare operational reports and summaries
  • Assist with proposals and RFP responses
  • Conduct vendor and pricing research
  • Support contract and operational research
  • Maintain structured documentation and shared files
  • Compile accurate information for leadership decision-making

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Support leadership with execution-heavy operational responsibilities
  • Assist with executive email and communication workflows
  • Coordinate meetings and scheduling
  • Manage communication through Microsoft Outlook and Teams
  • Keep action items organized and ensure follow-through
  • Identify process gaps or inconsistencies proactively
  • Escalate time-sensitive matters quickly and accurately

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • Previous experience in one or more of the following:
    • Operations coordination
    • Administrative support
    • Billing and invoicing
    • Scheduling
    • Workflow coordination
  • Strong proficiency with:
    • Microsoft Excel
    • Outlook
    • Word
    • Teams
    • OneDrive
  • Experience working with CRM systems
  • Strong spreadsheet and data-management skills
  • Excellent written English communication
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple workflows and deadlines simultaneously
  • Strong organizational and follow-through skills
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Availability to work U.S. EST business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Aspire
  • Experience with Azuga
  • Familiarity with CompanyCam
  • Experience in:
    • Construction
    • Landscaping
    • Field services
    • Operations-heavy service businesses
  • Experience coordinating payroll or employee time tracking
  • Understanding of job costing
  • Accounts receivable and payment follow-up experience
  • Experience preparing proposals or RFP responses

Tools & Tech

Microsoft Excel | Outlook | Word | Teams | OneDrive | Aspire | Azuga | CompanyCam | CRM Systems | Google Sheets

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re extremely organized and detail-oriented
  • You care about getting information right the first time
  • You naturally notice missing information, inconsistencies, and unfinished tasks
  • You’re comfortable working inside structured systems and processes
  • You can manage several operational workflows without dropping details
  • You proactively follow up instead of waiting to be reminded
  • You remain calm and organized when priorities shift
  • You take ownership of execution and follow-through

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start your day reviewing schedules and active jobs, checking for time discrepancies or operational issues, and updating CRM records.

From there, you might process invoices, review outstanding payments, respond to client inquiries, coordinate scheduling changes, update spreadsheets, prepare a report for leadership, or follow up on incomplete operational tasks.

Throughout the day, you’ll keep systems organized and ensure important details don’t get lost between clients, crews, accounting, and leadership.

In short: you keep the business organized, accurate, and moving forward day-to-day.

Key Metrics for Success

  • CRM and operational data accuracy
  • Accurate and timely invoicing
  • Clean accounts receivable tracking
  • Scheduling and time-tracking accuracy
  • Zero missed client follow-ups
  • Timely completion of operational tasks
  • Proactive identification of discrepancies and issues
  • Leadership confidence in operational reliability

Operational Environment

This role is execution-heavy, systems-driven, and detail-critical.

You’ll have clear workflows, defined expectations, and direct access to leadership while taking ownership of:

Accuracy | Consistency | Follow-Through | Organization | Operational Reliability

Growth Path

Strong performance can create opportunities to grow into roles such as:

Operations Manager | Senior Operations Coordinator | Executive Operations | Chief of Staff-style responsibilities

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Operations / Systems-Focused Interview
  4. Practical Workflow or Scenario Task
  5. Final Interview
  6. Internal Review & Offer

Apply Now

If you’re highly organized, systems-oriented, strong with CRM management, Excel, billing, scheduling, and administrative operations, and you take pride in keeping a business running accurately behind the scenes, we’d love to hear from you.

Who We Are

Point32Health is a leading not-for-profit health and well-being organization dedicated to delivering high-quality, affordable healthcare. Serving nearly 2 million members, Point32Health builds on the legacy of Harvard Pilgrim Health Care and Tufts Health Plan to provide access to care and empower healthier lives for everyone. Our culture revolves around being a community of care and having shared values that guide our behaviors and decisions. We’ve had a long-standing commitment to inclusion and equal healthcare access and outcomes, regardless of background; it’s at the core of who we are. We value the rich mix of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all of our colleagues, which helps us to provide service with empathy and better understand and meet the needs of the communities where we serve, live, and work.

We enjoy the important work we do every day in service to our members, partners, colleagues and communities. Learn more about who we are at Point32Health.

Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Broker & Employer Services is responsible for leading the strategy, performance, operations, and transformation of Point32Health's Broker and Employer servicing functions. This role serves as a key leader within the Service & Experience division and is accountable for delivering an exceptional end-to-end experience while advancing enterprise priorities related to growth, retention, operational excellence, digital adoption, and customer satisfaction.
The Senior Manager serves as the voice of brokers and employers across Point32Health, translating customer insights, operational data, and service trends into actionable business improvements. Working across Sales, Account Management, Operations, Product, Digital, Technology, and Business teams, this leader identifies opportunities to simplify experiences, reduce customer effort, modernize service delivery, and strengthen broker and employer relationships.
This role requires a strategic and customer-focused leader who can balance operational execution with transformational change, building scalable service capabilities that support Point32Health's future growth and service excellence objectives.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities/Duties – what you will be doing (top five):

  • Strategic Leadership & Transformation

    • Develop and execute the Broker and Employer Services strategy in alignment with Service & Experience and enterprise priorities.
    • Lead transformation initiatives that improve the broker and employer experience while advancing service quality, efficiency, digital adoption, and organizational effectiveness.
    • Anticipate future customer, market, and business needs and develop scalable servicing models that support growth and evolving expectations.
    • Partner with enterprise leaders to influence service, operational, and customer experience strategies through data-driven recommendations and insights.
    • Serve as a champion for innovation, continuous improvement, and customer-centric thinking across the organization.

    Broker & Employer Experience Leadership

    • Own the end-to-end broker and employer service experience across all channels and touchpoints.
    • Serve as the primary advocate for brokers and employers, ensuring customer needs are reflected in enterprise priorities, processes, and solutions.
    • Identify service, operational, and process breakdowns that create friction and lead cross-functional efforts to resolve them.
    • Use customer feedback, service interactions, complaint trends, and performance metrics to identify opportunities to improve the overall customer experience.
    • Partner with Sales, Account Management, Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to improve broker and employer satisfaction, retention, and loyalty.
    Operational Excellence
    • Lead day-to-day Broker and Employer Services operations, ensuring delivery of high-quality, efficient, and compliant service.
    • Drive performance against key metrics including service level, quality, customer satisfaction, first contact resolution, productivity, customer effort, and operational efficiency.
    • Establish consistent processes, controls, and service standards that support operational excellence and sustainable performance.
    • Lead efforts to simplify work, eliminate waste, reduce variation, and improve the effectiveness of service delivery.
    • Ensure operational readiness for business, regulatory, and organizational changes.
    Digital Enablement & Service Modernization
    • Partner with Digital, Technology, Product, and Operations teams to define and implement future-state servicing capabilities.
    • Lead adoption of self-service solutions, automation, AI-enabled technologies, workflow optimization, and digital servicing strategies.
    • Identify opportunities to shift interactions to lower-effort channels while improving customer outcomes.
    • Support development of an integrated and seamless omnichannel servicing experience.
    Data, Insights & Performance Management
    • Use operational, customer, and business data to identify opportunities, risks, trends, and performance improvement opportunities.
    • Develop performance scorecards, dashboards, and executive-level reporting to drive accountability and transparency.
    • Translate data into meaningful insights and recommendations that influence business decisions.
    • Monitor emerging trends and proactively recommend solutions that improve customer and business outcomes.
    Workforce & Organizational Leadership
    • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team focused on service excellence, accountability, innovation, and collaboration.
    • Lead through managers and supervisors while fostering an inclusive, engaged, and performance-driven culture.
    • Develop workforce strategies, staffing models, succession plans, and organizational capabilities that align resources to current and future business needs.
    • Coach and develop leaders to strengthen leadership effectiveness, employee engagement, and business performance.
    • Drive talent development and create growth opportunities across the Broker & Employer Services organization.
    Financial & Business Stewardship
    • Be accountable for financial management of Broker and Employer Services operations, including resource planning, budget management, and financial performance monitoring.
    • Ensure effective utilization of people, technology, and vendor resources to achieve business objectives.
    • Evaluate investments, initiatives, and business opportunities through the lens of customer value, operational effectiveness, and enterprise outcomes.
    • Support achievement of enterprise growth, retention, and service goals through operational excellence and customer experience improvements.

  • Other duties and projects as assigned.

Qualifications – what you need to perform the job

Certification and Licensure

Education

  • Required (minimum): Bachelor’s degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Preferred: Master’s degree

Experience (minimum years required):

  • Required (minimum):

  • 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in service operations, customer experience, broker services, employer services, healthcare operations, or related business functions.
    5+ years of leadership experience managing managers, supervisors, or professional staff.
    Demonstrated experience driving transformational change, operational excellence, and customer experience improvement.
    Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.
    Strong analytical, problem-solving, and business acumen skills, with the ability to use data to drive decision-making.

  • Preferred:

Health plan, payer, broker, employer group, or healthcare services experience.

  • Experience with customer experience strategy, contact center operations, digital servicing, CRM platforms, automation, or AI-enabled technologies.

  • Experience leading organizational design, workforce planning, or large-scale change initiatives.

  • Lean, Six Sigma, continuous improvement, or operational excellence certification.

Skill Requirements

  • Experience in project management, team leadership and supervision.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills required.

  • Superior operational problem-solving skills

  • Ability to make independent decisions that affect staff work volume, priorities, and goals.

Working Conditions and Additional Requirements (include special requirements, e.g., lifting, travel):

We are launching a Management Consulting domain focused on translating real-world consulting engagements into structured learning environments for advanced AI systems. To do this credibly, we are assembling a team of strategy consultants from top-tier firms who can convert authentic project experience into end-to-end examples — from problem structuring and work planning to analysis, synthesis, and client-ready recommendations.

You will join a growing team of consultants from leading strategy firms shaping how AI learns high-level business reasoning.

Important: This role is exclusively for consultants with direct experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm. If you do not have hands-on project experience at one of the firms listed below, please do not apply. This requirement ensures the domain is built by practitioners trained to the highest standards of structured problem-solving and client delivery.

Eligible firms: McKinsey & Company, Boston Consulting Group (BCG), Bain & Company, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Monitor Deloitte (Deloitte S&C), EY-Parthenon, Kearney, and Strategy& (PwC).

Who We’re Looking For

Consultants with 3+ years of experience at one of the firms listed above, with hands-on project experience in:

  • Structuring ambiguous client problems into workable analytical plans
  • Building financial models, market analyses, or synthesized findings from messy inputs
  • Producing client-ready deliverables under time pressure
  • Forming and defending recommendations under uncertainty

No deep technical background is required — we will onboard you on the lightweight tools involved.

What You’ll Do

  • Build realistic consulting project environments — create detailed project scenarios grounded in real engagement dynamics: industry context, financials, constraints, conflicting inputs, and incomplete information.
  • Design structured consulting tasks for AI agents — break projects into discrete tasks that mirror real consulting work: market sizing, commercial due diligence, cost optimization, growth strategy, operational diagnosis, benchmarking, and more.
  • Define evaluation criteria and quality standards — develop grading frameworks, evaluation rubrics, and golden-answer solutions for each task, used to train and calibrate an LLM-based grading system that evaluates AI outputs at scale.

This is a remote, project-based, individual-contributor role focused on analytical design and evaluation.

  • 3+ years at McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Monitor Deloitte, EY-Parthenon, Kearney, or Strategy&
  • Strong structured problem-solving and hypothesis-driven thinking
  • Ability to translate vague problems into clear analytical steps and deliverables
  • High attention to logical consistency and output quality
  • Independent, self-directed working style
  • Clear written English (B2+)

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $60 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst to join our Go-to-Market Applications team, where the systems we build directly power how CrowdStrike sells, partners, and grows. Our team designs, builds, and ships the capabilities that let Sales and Channel pitch new products, enter new markets, deepen partner relationships, and adopt new selling motions — from self-service eCommerce to complex, multi-year enterprise deals.

In this role, you'll be the liaison between our business partners and our engineering teams. You'll develop a deep understanding of our quote, order, and revenue processes, then translate that understanding into scalable solutions across Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, and the broader Lead-to-Cash ecosystem. You'll act as a strategic consultant, constructively challenging requests, proposing better alternatives, and using AI to move from idea to production faster than traditional delivery models allow.

This role is part of a globally distributed team. You'll partner daily with engineers, QA, and analysts across US and offshore locations, and with stakeholders in multiple regions — so comfort operating asynchronously, documenting clearly, and flexing occasionally for early or late calls is essential to how we work.

Your mission is simple: make it easier to do business at CrowdStrike.

Requested in lieu of a cover letter:

Tell us about one project where your analysis changed the outcome. Start with a short intro paragraph describing the business problem and why it was hard, then give us no more than 10 bullet points of specific actions you took that led to the result. If AI played a role in how you got there, we want to hear about it.

What You'll Do:

  • Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Channel, Professional Services, Finance, and Revenue Operations to lead requirements-gathering sessions, prioritize competing requests, and set pragmatic expectations.

  • Own functional deliverables end to end: process definition, requirements, fit/gap analysis, functional design, test planning and execution, training, and post-launch support.

  • Drive the pre-research phase independently — analyze data, validate assumptions, and identify trends without relying on developers to do your discovery for you.

  • Assess systemic impact of every change across the Quote-to-Cash ecosystem, including downstream effects on provisioning, entitlements, billing, and reporting.

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate the delivery lifecycle — drafting requirements and user stories, generating functional designs and test cases, building proof of concepts and accelerators, and analyzing data to inform recommendations.

  • Apply AI-powered capabilities within the Salesforce platform (e.g., Agentforce, Einstein) to design experiences that reduce manual effort for sellers and partners.

  • Independently facilitate sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, backlog grooming, and cross-functional design sessions following Agile best practices.

  • Create and maintain process documentation, functional and architectural design artifacts, and Salesforce configuration best practices.

  • Help shape the custom-versus-configuration conversation, advocating for scalable, upgrade-safe solutions over one-off workarounds.

  • Stay ahead of Salesforce release cycles and industry practices, proactively bringing new capabilities to the business before they ask for them.

  • Build a fanatical focus on the seller and partner experience into everything you deliver.

What You'll Need:

  • 5+ years implementing, configuring, and supporting SaaS business systems at a software company, including at least 2 years hands-on with Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud or any other CPQ application.

  • Working knowledge of the Lead-to-Cash / Quote-to-Cash lifecycle — products and price books, quoting and approvals, amendments and renewals, orders, and the handoff to billing.

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools to improve your own throughput and decision-making, with specific examples of where it changed your output or timeline.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize ambiguous input into clear requirements and evaluate trade-offs across options.

  • Comfort working directly with data — building reports and dashboards, running queries or extracts, and using data to support a recommendation.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to and influencing senior leadership.

  • Solid understanding of the Salesforce platform, its ecosystem, and its declarative capabilities (Flow, validation rules, security model, sharing).

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

  • Detail-oriented, organized, self-motivated, and a genuine team player who thrives in a fast-moving environment.

  • Bachelor's degree (technical degree preferred) or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus Points:

  • Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA) project delivery experience.

  • Salesforce certifications: Administrator, Advanced Administrator, CPQ Specialist, Revenue Cloud, or Business Analyst.

  • Experience with partner/channel commerce, distributor and reseller models, or marketplace and eCommerce selling motions.

  • Familiarity with adjacent Quote-to-Cash tooling (billing systems, CLM, tax, ERP integrations).

  • Ability to read Apex, SOQL, or LWC well enough to collaborate credibly with developers and troubleshoot independently.

  • Consulting background, including Big 4.

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs

  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge

  • Paid parental and adoption leaves

  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections

  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

Position Description & Requirements

WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO:
Radiology Partners, through its affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation. As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, our mission is to transform radiology by innovating across clinical value, technology, service, and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.

POSITION SUMMARY:

  • Provide analytical and operational support to the Integrations team by analyzing data, identifying trends, and delivering insights that drive operational improvements and strategic decision-making.
  • Develop reports, dashboards, and executive-ready materials that track key performance indicators and support leadership decision-making.
  • Partner with Operations and cross-functional teams to identify inefficiencies, optimize processes, and implement strategic initiatives that improve operational performance.
  • Use Excel, Smartsheet, and other analytical tools to organize and manipulate data, develop actionable recommendations, and support operational objectives.
  • Manage assigned projects, documentation, and deliverables while ensuring accurate tracking of key metrics and successful execution of initiatives.

DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree required with 1-3 years of experience in healthcare, investment banking, consulting, corporate development, or a related analytical field preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, Smartsheet, PowerPoint, and Tableau with experience developing reports, dashboards, and data-driven presentations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large datasets, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience collaborating across Operations, Finance, IT, Revenue Cycle, HR, Analytics, Clinical, or other cross-functional teams; healthcare, financial, accounting, or quantitative background preferred.
  • Highly motivated self-starter with excellent organizational, communication, and teamwork skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

WHY RADIOLOGY PARTNERS:

  • Competitive Benefits package – Eligibility starts the month after hire, with tiered options to choose from.
  • Compensation Reviews, Career Growth Opportunities
  • Flexible Remote Schedules
  • Generous PTO Plans and Paid Holidays
  • Proudly Certified as a Great Place to Work for Five Consecutive Years

FOR MORE INFORMATION:

Job Link for Job Description

COMPENSATION:
The salary range for this position is $60,000-$65,000. Final determinations may vary based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, geographic location, etc. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to this range, Radiology Partners offers competitive total rewards packages, which include health & wellness coverage options, 401(k) benefits, and a broad range of other benefits such as family planning and telehealth (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements).

Radiology Partners is an equal opportunity employer. RP is committed to being an inclusive, safe and welcoming environment where everyone has equal access and equitable resources to reach their full potential. We are united by our Mission to Transform Radiology and in turn have an important impact on the patients we serve and the healthcare system overall. We hold that diversity is a key source of strength from which we will build a practice culture that is inclusive for all. Our goal is to empower and engage the voice of every teammate to promote awareness, compassion and a healthy respect for differences.

Become a part of our caring community

The Process Improvement Professional 2 supports corporate and market programs by identifying opportunities to improve outcomes, strengthen compliance, and enhance operational effectiveness. This role partners with business stakeholders to research and analyze business processes, develop action plans, document workflows, and update policies and procedures in alignment with state contract and regulatory requirements.
The position applies data, process mapping, and quality assurance practices to support compliance and continuous improvement across healthcare programs, including long-term care. The Process Improvement Professional 2 also facilitates meetings, communicates process and policy updates, and collaborates with systems partners to improve internal documentation tools and ensure processes are clear, current, and effective. Reports to the Regional Process Improvement Manager.
  • Identify and execute process improvement opportunities that enhance outcomes and support corporate and market program performance.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to develop, implement, and track corrective action plans that ensure ongoing program compliance.
  • Research, analyze, and synthesize cross-functional inputs to define problems, validate root causes, and drive assigned initiatives to completion.
  • Lead process mapping and procedure development using structured project management and continuous improvement methods.
  • Interpret and apply state contract and regulatory requirements; proactively adjust processes to remain compliant.

Use your skills to make an impact

  • 1+ years of experience in quality, performance, compliance, or process improvement, with demonstrated experience supporting operational effectiveness and quality assurance initiatives.
  • Project management experience.
  • 1+ years of experience with Microsoft Power Platform tools (i.e., Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Tableau).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project Management Certification

The Territory Sales Manager is responsible for driving growth through the sales of DeepHealth’s uniquely positioned AI-powered Radiology Operating System and Enterprise Imaging Platform, specifically targeting radiology practices, diagnostic imaging centers, and hospitals and health systems. The Territory Sales Manager is the primary point of contact for prospects and clients in the West region, building relationships, understanding clinical and operational challenges, and delivering scalable imaging solutions that improve productivity, operational efficiency, and outcomes.

Requirements

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute territory sales strategy, with full accountability for new bookings and opportunity development within radiology practices, imaging centers, and hospitals/health systems.
  • Develop and manage a robust pipeline of provider accounts across the West through self-sourced outreach, strategic campaigns, and partner channels.
  • Engage clinical (radiologists), operational (imaging directors), and IT (CIO, CMIO) stakeholders to deliver tailored product presentations and lead complex sales cycles.
  • Build strong relationships that drive business case development around workflow optimization, AI triage/prioritization, and imaging platform consolidation.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales Engineering, Product, Client Success, and Marketing to align solutions to buyer needs and accelerate deal velocity.
  • Maintain pipeline hygiene and accurate forecasting within Salesforce.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of B2B sales experience in healthcare IT, SaaS, imaging solutions, or medical device sales.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; clinical, healthcare informatics, or technical background preferred.
  • Track record of selling into radiology groups, imaging centers, or hospitals/health systems
  • Deep understanding of healthcare buyer personas and enterprise purchasing processes
  • Consultative, value-based selling approach with strong interpersonal and presentation skills
  • Comfortable working remotely and managing territory travel (including overnight travel as required)
  • Valid U.S. driver’s license and reliable transportation
  • Experience selling PACS, VNA, RIS, AI-based imaging tools, or radiology workflow software.
  • Knowledge of radiologist staffing challenges, imaging economics, and value-based care delivery.
  • Familiarity with the procurement lifecycle in healthcare, including RFI/RFP management and IT/security review.
  • Previous success selling into multi-site provider networks or regional health systems

Physical Demands

This position often requires sitting, standing, walking, bending, twisting, reaching with hands and arms, using hands and fingers, handling, or feeling, speaking, listening, and high-level cognitive thinking. Also, must be able to lift up to 10 pounds occasionally. The position requires the ability to travel up to 50% of the time, drive a vehicle, and utilize other forms of transportation.

50% Domestic Travel Required.

Salary range; $150,000-$170,000

What You Will Do:

The Technical Lead supports the design and implementation of interoperable public health data exchange and AI solutions. This role contributes to technical guidance, design collaboration, and standards-based approaches to help ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with public health workflows, data governance needs, and applicable interoperability standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the technical design and execution of data exchange, interoperability, and AI/ML solutions supporting surveillance, reporting, analytics, and related public health use cases.

  • Responsible for overall QA/QC and troubleshooting solutions encountered across the tech stack.

  • Lead architects, engineers, analysts, and informaticists to translate client needs into technical approaches.

  • Support the application of interoperability standards such as HL7 v2, FHIR, CDA, APIs, and terminology systems within public health contexts.

  • Lead technical discussions, design sessions, and reviews; help document decisions, assumptions, and dependencies.

  • Review technical deliverables and documentation for alignment with scope, requirements, and quality expectations.

  • Identify technical considerations related to integration, security, privacy, onboarding, and data-sharing constraints, and discuss potential mitigation options with the team.

  • Support integration testing, validation, and exchange troubleshooting activities when applicable.

  • Share technical knowledge and lessons learned across projects and support mentoring of junior staff.

What You Will Need:

  • A bachelor’s Degree is required

  • A minimum of FIVE (5) years of previous experience serving in a Technical Lead role

  • Knowledge and experience assisting clients in modernizing and implementing technology solutions (Cloud, AI, analytics, and data management).

  • Knowledge across the tech stack, from underlying infrastructure needs, UI/UX design, analytics, and system maintenance.

  • Ability to document system integration and support flow analysis and review detailed technical documentation.

  • Public health informatics experience specifically in public health surveillance, epidemiology workflows, and STLT public health operations.

  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to a nontechnical public.

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving.

  • Demonstrated experience with public health data exchange and interoperability across PHAs, laboratories, registries, healthcare partners, and federal systems.

  • Working knowledge of public health standards and artifacts (e.g., HL7 v2, CDA, FHIR).

What Would Be Nice To Have:

  • Demonstrated experience in generative AI and agentic research versus other methods of automation.

  • Deep knowledge of public health standards and artifacts (e.g., HL7 v2, CDA, FHIR).

raw.description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:

Dexcom is a leader in diabetes management technology and is proactively developing solutions to address new and expanding areas of opportunity for diabetes treatment, and improved health. The US is the largest market with significant growth opportunities, and the trade team will be instrumental in achieving our goals. This leader will shape the trajectory of Dexcom’s success in the growing CGM category, and will be poised for future growth opportunities within an evolving and dynamic company.

Where you come in:

  • The New Business Development Manager, Partnerships will be tasked with leading the strategy and engagement with new Trade Channels including retail and eCommerce. This candidate will be a key contributor in helping to expand access and utilization of Dexcom’s non-insulin, OTC CGMs’.
  • Own the growth plan for the Stelo commercial wholesale channel, leading the plan to deliver revenue and volume targets. Owning the commercial distribution plan by partnering with Marketing, Sales development leads and operational teams to penetrate the emerging wellness and concierge medicine market.
  • You will help lead the strategy to identify, assess and engage with potential partners to bring our new OTC CGM to market in unique and creative ways, brining new ideas forward for distribution and access expansion.
  • You will take ownership of the partnership contracting process from ideation to launch and then nurture these partnerships for continued growth via growing our throughput of CGM sensors. This includes everything from co-branded device marketing to optimizing the methods of product distribution.
  • You’re able to think strategically about partnership opportunities and measure the overall impacts to building brand equity, awareness, and commercial outcomes.
  • You can analyze a prospective partners business model and build the strategy around where a CGM (and the data from using a CGM) fit into the broader service proposition from a prospective partner.

What makes you successful:

  • You have experience in building and executing strategic partnerships in either the medical, technical and consumer goods categories.
  • Experience managing commercial trade and strategic sales relationships with national retailers and eRetailers such as Walmart and Amazon.
  • Comfortable managing complex pricing and contracting agreements and negotiations.
  • You have experience in identifying new business opportunities and building compelling sell-stories to drive a meaningful engagement.
  • You have managed external relationships and partnerships from prospecting through renewals.
  • You understand how to engage and work with cross-functional teams to generate results internally and the curiosity and business acumen to understand the potential partnership opportunities.

What you’ll get:

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.
  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.
  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required:

  • 25 to 50%

Experience and Education:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 8-12 years of related experience.
  • At this level a graduate degree may be expected with 4 years of related experience.

Remote Workplace:Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex workplace option.

raw.description:
Our client runs a high-volume customer support operation on Zendesk, and the platform is the backbone of how thousands of patients get help every day. You'll own the Zendesk instance end to end — keeping it fast, clean, and smart — so support agents spend their time helping customers instead of fighting their tools.

This is a hands-on administrator role for someone who treats a support platform like a product: measured, iterated, and always improving.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the instance — manage users, roles, groups, brands, and views; keep the configuration clean as the team scales.
  • Build the automation layer — design and maintain triggers, automations, macros, and SLA policies that route tickets to the right people at the right time.
  • Connect the stack — manage integrations with the tools around Zendesk (telephony, messaging, e-commerce/billing systems, internal apps) and troubleshoot when data stops flowing.
  • Run the numbers — build and maintain dashboards and reporting (Zendesk Explore) on volume, response times, CSAT, and agent performance; surface what leadership needs to see.
  • Improve the workflows — partner with CX leadership to spot friction, test changes, and roll out improvements to routing, forms, help center content, and self-service flows.
  • Support the team — onboard new agents, document processes, and act as the go-to resource for anything Zendesk.

Requirements

  • 3+ years administering Zendesk at meaningful ticket volume — Support required; Explore, Guide, Talk, and Chat experience strongly preferred.
  • Automation fluency — you've built non-trivial trigger and automation logic and know how to keep it from becoming spaghetti.
  • Integration experience — comfortable with Zendesk apps and marketplace tools; API/webhook familiarity is a strong plus.
  • Data instincts — you can build a clean Explore dashboard and explain what it says.
  • AI-forward mindset — experience with Zendesk AI features (bots, intelligent triage) or a demonstrated appetite to deploy them; comfort using AI tools in your own workflow is expected.
  • Strong written and spoken English — you'll work directly with a US-based CX and leadership team.
  • US timezone overlap — availability during US business hours.

Benefits

Why This Role

  • Own the platform outright — no committee, no layers; you propose it, you ship it.
  • High-visibility work: support performance is a leadership-level metric at this company.
  • Long-term, stable engagement through Maxana with direct integration into the client's team.
  • Fully remote with LATAM-friendly hours.
  • Competitive pay

In this role, you will be the primary technical lead for our data exchange ecosystem, ensuring that enrollment and contribution data for FSA, HSA, HRA, and COBRA plans flow seamlessly between employers, carriers, and our administration platform. As part of a small, collaborative team, this role requires versatility and ownership across a broad range of responsibilities from high-level partner onboarding to detailed troubleshooting of daily data file transmissions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Benefits Enrollment Management: Configure, validate, and monitor EDI 834 (Enrollment and Maintenance) transactions to ensure accurate processing of new hires, qualifying life events, and terminations across all benefit plans.
  • Partner Onboarding & Integration: Lead the technical implementation and onboarding of new employer groups and insurance carriers, establishing secure data exchange connections via SFTP, AS2, or other approved protocols.
  • Compliance & HIPAA Oversight: Ensure all data exchanges meet strict HIPAA security standards to protect Protected Health Information (PHI).
  • Data Mapping & Transformation: Develop, test, and maintain EDI maps and transformation rules to translate incoming employer and payroll data into standardized system formats, ensuring data integrity and consistency.
  • Troubleshooting & Support: Proactively identify and resolve file rejections or data mismatches before they impact employee access to their health funds.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with Account Management, Claims, and Operations teams to support a high-quality client experience and ensure accurate, timely data flow across systems.

Key Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years in EDI, specifically within healthcare or benefits administration
  • Knowledge of health benefits (HSA, FSA, HRA, COBRA) and the life events that trigger data changes.
  • A self-starter comfortable in a small-business environment where you own the process from start to finish.
  • Strong mastery of ANSI X12 standards, specifically 834 (Enrollment) and ideally 820 (Premium Payments).
  • Hands-on experience with EDI translation tools and SQL for data validation.

About Us:

Rocky Mountain Reserve provides employee benefits to other companies as a service. The benefits we provide to our clients are FSA, HSA, and COBRA administration. Our mission is to enable employees to save money for needed healthcare costs through these benefits. Providing outstanding customer service is paramount to that mission. We strive to make the world of health benefits easier to understand and simpler to navigate.

At Rocky Mountain Reserve our customer service team is the backbone of our company! You will play an integral role in the success and growth of our company and the reputation we have with our clients. Our Client Services Team is responsible for assisting participants via inbound calls, emails, and chats.

We pride ourselves on our team's professionalism and dedication to excellence. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a dynamic and experienced Customer Service Manager to join our team and contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional customer service.

Benefits:

  • Health/Dental/Vision Coverage
  • 401k with employer match
  • Generous PTO & Paid Holidays
  • A Monday-Friday Schedule (No nights or weekends)
  • Opportunity for growth and development.
  • The chance to be a part of a growing company that values customer service

Join us in delivering exceptional service and support to our participants and clients. We look forward to reviewing your application.

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Solutions Integration Engineer at Samsara, you will be an integral member of the Professional Services Organisation responsible for helping Samsara’s most strategic customers build and implement B2B integrations with our IoT platform. In a given week, you may work with a large long-haul trucking company, an industrial-scale food producer, and a public utility to map a customer’s integration needs to current and future API capabilities, help building custom integrations, provide guidance and technical training to implementation teams to follow best practices, troubleshoot issues and advocate for fixes on behalf of customers (working with our tech support team), and ensure a successful customer relationship. A successful Solutions Integration Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of B2B integrations to ensure the proper technical solution is delivered to our customers.

Your role will be cross-functional, working alongside and connecting product managers, business operations, sales, and systems engineers, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within. Since Samsara is a fast-growing company with emerging IoT technology, you can expect this role to evolve, with opportunities to take on increasing levels of responsibility and impact our growth.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead system integration projects with customer development teams, Samsara’s partners, 3rd-party systems integrators or build your own enterprise-grade scalable solutions using various Samsara’s Web integration technologies (APIs, Webhooks, Connectors, and more.)
  • Design/develop/define complex project scopes, technical specifications and business requirements between Samsara and multiple stakeholders - from design through delivery and beyond
  • Plans complex projects that involve a variety of people, dependencies, uncertainty, risk and impact. Comfortable making delivery commitments for larger projects
  • Accounts for maintainability, portability, scalability, and reliability in technical designs and knows when to trade them for speed of delivery
  • Build robust and scalable integration architecture to help solve use cases like Real-time Data Streaming, Event subscriptions, Batch processing, etc.
  • Build, test, validate, and review code to ensure completeness and highest quality deliverables
  • Advise and document best practices around integrations using Samara APIs and products
  • Test, validate and review code to ensure completeness and highest quality deliverables
  • Leads by example: conducts thorough code reviews and provides feedback that is actionable and insightful
  • Exchange best practices, share knowledge with the Samsara product team, developer community, and advocate for customer experience
  • Collaborate with the Samsara’s Developer EcoSystem team closely to improve our API experience and featureset
  • Contribute to the enhancement of Professional Services methodologies and tools
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience designing and developing Integration solutions using proven architecture methodologies
  • Experience in gathering data integration requirements and translating into good technical data designs
  • Can write, read, and understand code in Python and any one additional programming language (for example, JavaScript, AppScript)
  • Proficient in leveraging LLM-based tools for code generation, prompt engineering, automation, and enhancing developer productivity
  • Experience with agentic workflows, including the design, orchestration, and deployment of multi-agent systems for enterprise use cases
  • 3+ years hands-on experience in developing solutions leveraging any of the modern Cloud Services (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Hands-on experience in building or working with RESTful APIs/Webhooks and modern databases
  • Knowledge of PowerBI/Tableau, SQL, and data visualization concepts is a huge plus
  • Hands-on experience with customer evaluations and deployments, with the ability to juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel
  • Proven ability to effectively manage complex projects with a wide range of stakeholders including C-Level executives
  • Strong written communication and presentation skills, demonstrated ability to work with a diverse set of teams
  • Proficient in using GitHub for version control and collaboration
  • Experience working with Modern Agile tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence)

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
  • Minimum 3+ years customer facing experience building and supporting Enterprise-scale integrations or API scripting
  • Consistent track record of configuring and deploying complex technical solutions
  • Familiarity with B2B system integration projects and workflows
  • Bias-to-action and hands-on experience delivering business results
  • Tinkering with hardware gadgets, sensors, or vehicles is a plus
  • Familiarity with fleets and logistics is a plus
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems is a plus

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$73,780—$111,600 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Job Description

The Richard W. Riley College of Education and Human Sciences seek part-time faculty to serve as methodologists on dissertation committees for our Ed.D. and Ph.D. programs. Contributing faculty are primarily responsible for student research mentoring within the school's doctoral degree programs. Specifically, they are required to serve on and/or chair dissertation committees These faculty members will report to the Associate Dean or designer.

Primary duties and responsibilities include:

  • Serve as methodologist on doctoral committees in either the position of chair or second member.
  • Complete required faculty trainings

Roles and Responsibilities for Methodologist and URR Committee Membership

The Role of Methodology Expert

  • Provides feedback to students on the following:
    • Proposed research design including appropriateness for addressing the problem statement and research questions or for testing stated hypotheses
    • Selection of specific methodology
    • Selection of a sample of appropriate characteristics and size
    • Oversee implementation of the selected methodology, assuring compliance with the following:
      • Program/professional norms
      • Generally accepted ethical and moral principles regarding human subjects
  • Provides constructive feedback about the following:
    • Data collection and analysis
    • Presentation of the data and the conclusions drawn from the analysis
  • Doctoral degree in the field of Education, or related field from an accredited university
  • Strong research methodology background in quantitative, qualitative (preferred) and/or mixed methods.
  • A significant record of intellectual and professional contributions to the field of Education, or related field, including peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations.
  • Experience serving on doctoral dissertation committees is required.
  • Three to five years of independent research project mentoring is preferred.
  • Commitment to advocating for the learning and development needs of students earning their degrees in a distance learning environment; supervising student research preferred at the graduate level; commitment to the promotion of research that contributes to Walden's mission of contributing to positive social change; commitment to advocating for the learning and development needs of students earning their degrees in a distance learning environment.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, team, and human relation skills.
  • Experience with distance learning is preferred.

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected compensation rate for this position is as follows:

  • Graduate Course Instruction: $1,560 - $4,080 per Quarter or Semester, depending on type of course taught and length of course
  • Undergraduate Course Instruction: $700 - $2,200 per quarter, depending on type of course taught and length of course

    Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Walden also offers other opportunities for its contributing faculty members, such as dissertation/doctoral study committee chair positions, research reviewing, and dissertation and doctoral study mentoring.

    For more information regarding these opportunities, including the Faculty Compensation Schedule, please Click Here.

Equal Opportunity – Minority / Female / Disability / V / Gender Identity / Sexual Orientation

About Walden University

Walden University, a Covista institution, supports a diverse community of adult learners from across the U.S. and other countries, who seek to achieve their academic goals and make positive, lasting social change in their professions and communities. Walden offers more than 100 online degree and certificate programs, for students pursuing a bachelor’s, master’s, doctoral or certificate. Walden University has graduated more than 174,000 students and is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission.

Visit WaldenU.edu for more information, and follow on Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn.
