🚨 MUST-HAVE: Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Führung von Callcenter-Teams sowie eigene, fundierte Outbound-Erfahrung sind für diese Position zwingend erforderlich.

Standort: 100% Remote | Umfang: 30-40h / Woche

Über den Job:
Tunymedia ist auf Wachstumskurs. Wir generieren für unsere Kunden (Handwerksbetriebe) täglich Leads über Social Media, die von unserem Inhouse-Callcenter telefonisch vorqualifiziert werden. Da unser bestehendes Team bereits hervorragende Arbeit leistet und wir unsere Kapazitäten erweitern, suchen wir dich für die Steuerung und den Aufbau einer zweiten, parallelen Einheit, die zu 100% remote von zu Hause arbeitet.

Wir suchen Dich als erfahrene, externe Führungskraft, die nachweisliche Führungserfahrung aus dem Callcenter-Umfeld und handfeste Outbound-Erfahrung mitbringt. Du bist die treibende Kraft, die klare Strukturen vorgibt, messbare Ergebnisse einfordert, die Qualität sichert und selbst aktiv in der Lead-Terminierung mitwirkt. Umso besser unser Team ist, umso bessere Ergebnisse bekommt der Kunde.

🛑 Wichtig vorab (Bitte genau lesen)

Wir verfolgen keinen aggressiven Hard-Selling-Ansatz, suchen aber definitiv auch keine reine Moderatoren-Rolle, die operative Herausforderungen lediglich delegiert oder aussitzt.

Wir suchen eine umsetzungsstarke Führungspersönlichkeit, die durch klare Kommunikation, etablierte Prozesse und eigene Leistung am Hörer führt. Du verstehst die Lebensrealität unseres Teams und bietest höchste Verlässlichkeit.

Im Gegenzug forderst Du absolute Verbindlichkeit und Zielerreichung während der Arbeitszeit ein. Du verfügst über eine stark ausgeprägte, analytische und KPI-getriebene Arbeitsweise und hast die Durchsetzungskraft, bei abweichenden Quoten direkt einzugreifen, eine lückenlose CRM-Hygiene sicherzustellen und unsere Qualitätsstandards konsequent durchzusetzen.

Was Dich bei uns erwartet …
• Strukturierter Onboarding-Prozess: Ein effizienter Einarbeitungsplan mit persönlichem Training, damit Du unsere Meta-Leads, Skripte und internen Systeme schnell und umfassend beherrschst.
• Klare Arbeitsabläufe: Durch klare & ordentliche Anleitungen und Schulungen weiß jedes Teammitglied immer, was gerade zu tun ist. Damit vermeiden wir stressige Chaos-Situationen und Unordnung.
• Direkter Draht: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Produktionsleitung zusammen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, kein Konzern-Theater.
• 100% Remote & familiäres Umfeld: Du arbeitest komplett aus dem Home-Office. Wir schätzen Loyalität, Sicherheit und Wertschätzung und haben ein tiefes Verständnis für die Lebensrealität von Familien.
• Mitspracherecht: Nur gemeinsam können wir den Betrieb voranbringen, deswegen wird jeder Mitarbeiter in die Weiterentwicklung miteinbezogen!
• Langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeit: Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten im Unternehmen vorhanden, sowie selbstverantwortliches Arbeiten in einem offenen & ehrlichen Team.
• Umfangreiches Gesundheitsprogramm: Bikeleasing, höhenverstellbare Schreibtische (auch fürs Homeoffice), ergonomische Stühle, Gesundheitsworkshops uvm.

Über uns:
Die Tunymedia GmbH zählt mit über 350 Kunden zu den bekanntesten Digitalisierungsagenturen für die Handwerks- und Möbelbranche im gesamten D-A-CH Raum. Aktuell beschäftigen wir über 25 MitarbeiterInnen und helfen unseren Kunden durch Digitalisierung Top Fachkräfte zu gewinnen und mit mehr Neukundenaufträgen Ihren Gewinn zu steigern.

Zu unseren Kunden zählen viele Klein- und Mittelbetriebe, sowie auch bekannte große Unternehmen, wie Schaffrath, Flamme Möbel, Weko, Dan Küchen, HELLA Sonnenschutz und McDonalds.

Deine Aufgaben:Team-Führung & Entwicklung (Konsequente operative Führung)

  • Systematische Einarbeitung und Onboarding von neuen Mitarbeiterinnen nach unseren Unternehmensstandards.

  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und operatives Coaching unseres zweiten, parallel entstehenden Remote-Teams durch regelmäßige Call-Reviews und konstruktives Feedback.

  • Durchführung von Bewerbungsgesprächen zum gezielten Ausbau unseres Remote-Teams.

Operative Lead-Qualifizierung (Die Praxis)

  • Du steuerst nicht nur aus der Distanz: Du unterstützt das Team aktiv im Tagesgeschäft, qualifizierst Leads am Telefon und demonstrierst professionelle Einwandbehandlung in der Praxis.

Controlling & Prozessoptimierung (Die Struktur)

  • Tägliches Monitoring der Leistungskennzahlen (KPIs), Schlagzahlen und Termin-Ergebnisse.

  • Rigorose Sicherstellung einer fehlerfreien und lückenlosen Dokumentation im CRM-System.

  • Regelmäßiges Reporting an die Abteilungsleitung sowie sofortige strategische Maßnahmen bei Performance-Schwankungen.

Arbeitsort: 100% Remote

Gehalt: Sicheres Fixgehalt (je nach Erfahrung) + attraktives Prämienmodell bei Zielerreichung.

Requirements

Wen wir suchen (Dein Profil):

  • Entscheidungsstarke Teamleitung: Du bist niemand, der Probleme aussitzt. Du gibst glasklare Anweisungen, verteilst Aufgaben unmissverständlich und kontrollierst deren Umsetzung konsequent.

  • Erfahrung im Outbound / Lead-Qualifizierung: Du weißt, wie man am Telefon das Eis bricht, Einwände behandelt und Menschen qualifiziert. Ein reiner Inbound-Kundenservice-Hintergrund reicht hier nicht, du brauchst Drive.

  • Operatives Vorbild (Hands-on-Mentalität): Du telefonierst regelmäßig selbst, um Best Practices zu demonstrieren. Respekt im Team erarbeitest Du Dir durch fachliche Expertise und eigene Verbindlichkeit am Hörer.

  • Train the Trainer: Du kannst nachweisen, wie du Quereinsteigern Leitfäden beibringst, Call-Reviews durchführt und messbar die Abschlussquote im Team steigerst.

  • Analytischer Fokus & CRM-Exzellenz: Du arbeitest routiniert in Systemen wie Pipedrive/Hubspot, triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen und achtest rigoros auf eine lückenlose System-Dokumentation (die "Wahrheit im System").

  • Professionelle Autorität: Du kommunizierst direkt und auf Augenhöhe, bietest dem Team Verlässlichkeit durch exzellente Organisation und lieferst der Produktionsleitung gleichzeitig transparente, faktenbasierte Reportings.

Fluent is building the next generation advertising network, Partner Monetize & Advertiser Acquisition. Our vision is to build an ML/AI first network of advertisers and publishers to achieve a common objective, elevating relevancy in E-commerce for everyday shoppers.

As a Data Engineer on Fluent's Data Engineering team, you will bring your Databricks development expertise to build the data products that power Fluent's Audience Solutions business: the syndicated and custom consumer segments we build, model, and deliver to leading data marketplaces. These data products translate raw survey and behavioral signals into declared and modeled audiences that our commercial teams and clients rely on every day.

You are known as a strong and efficient IC Data Engineer, with the ability to assist in designing engineering solutions, data modeling, and building architecture. You are familiar with the Databricks Lakehouse and how to work backwards from translating business requirements into engineering solutions. You are considered an expert in Python, SQL, and Spark.

You will work closely with the Data Engineering team and Data Science partners to build and operate high-impact audience data solutions. This role is fully Remote in the United States or Canada, with occasional travel to NYC.

What You'll Do:

  • Majority of the role will be data engineering: tables, views, jobs/pipelines, and orchestration within the Databricks environment, following Fluent’s data model and architecture best practices. You will help elevate standards across testing, code repository, ci/cd, and naming conventions.
  • Build and maintain pipelines that create and deliver syndicated and custom audience segments, spanning declared (survey-based) and modeled (ML driven) methodologies.
  • Support delivery and performance reporting of finished segments on distribution marketplaces such as LiveRamp, TruAudience (TransUnion), and Lotame.
  • Investigate and leverage Databricks' latest capabilities for real-time processing and operational workloads, such as Spark structured Streaming and Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines.

raw.title: B2B Content and Growth Marketing Manager
raw.excerpt: About Bamboo WorksBamboo Works helps companies build global teams through flexible workforce solutions.
raw.description:
About Bamboo Works

Bamboo Works helps companies build global teams through flexible workforce solutions. We are evolving from a traditional remote staffing company into a more strategic global workforce partner, helping businesses increase capacity, access international talent, reduce operational bottlenecks, and build flexible teams that support long-term growth.

With a newly launched website and refreshed positioning, we're entering the next stage of our growth. We're also developing focused strategies within specific B2B industries—including accounting and professional services—where we see an opportunity to become a specialist workforce partner.

We're now looking for a B2B Content & Growth Marketing Manager to help turn that positioning into visibility, authority, and qualified demand.

The Role

This is a hands-on strategic marketing role for someone who can develop the strategy and execute it.

You won't simply receive a content calendar and be asked to publish posts. You'll work closely with our founders to understand Bamboo Works' commercial priorities, target markets, and positioning, then translate those into a clear and consistent organic marketing strategy.

Your initial focus will span content, SEO, GEO/AI search, social media, lead magnets, website optimization, email marketing, and organic lead generation.

Paid advertising and performance marketing are not a core part of this role. We're looking for someone who understands how high-quality content and organic marketing can compound over time to build authority and generate qualified B2B opportunities.

Role Details

Commitment: Part-Time (20 hours/week)

Working Hours: Philippine business hours

Location: Fully Remote (PH-based candidates preferred)

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Start Date: ASAP

Monthly Rate: USD $800–$960/month (on a 20-hour workweek), can be higher (depending on experience)

What You'll Do

Content Strategy & Execution

  • Develop and execute a consistent B2B content strategy aligned with Bamboo Works' positioning and commercial priorities.

  • Create content around global teams, workforce strategy, international talent, AI-enabled teams, and the business challenges our target customers face.

  • Build targeted content strategies for priority niches, particularly accounting and professional services.

  • Write and edit LinkedIn posts, blogs, articles, educational resources, and other marketing assets.

  • Research customer pain points, industry trends, questions, and topics that can be turned into valuable content.

  • Repurpose high-performing ideas across multiple channels and formats.

  • Maintain a clear, authoritative, and consistent Bamboo Works brand voice.

SEO, GEO & Organic Growth

  • Develop and execute an SEO strategy aligned with our commercial priorities.

  • Conduct keyword, competitor, audience, and topic research.

  • Build topical authority through useful, high-quality content.

  • Optimize existing website pages and identify opportunities for new search-focused content.

  • Help develop our approach to GEO / AI search visibility, ensuring Bamboo Works' content is discoverable across both traditional and AI-powered search experiences.

  • Monitor organic traffic, rankings, search visibility, and other relevant indicators.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to strengthen our organic acquisition funnel.

Lead Magnets & Demand Generation

Lead magnets will be an important part of our marketing strategy, and we're looking for someone who can help us create them at scale.

  • Develop high-value lead magnets such as guides, reports, checklists, templates, calculators, and other useful B2B resources.

  • Research topics and formats that genuinely address the needs of our target audiences.

  • Write and develop lead magnet content from concept through completion.

  • Identify opportunities to integrate lead magnets across our website, social content, and marketing funnel.

  • Develop supporting landing page copy and promotional content.

  • Work closely with Sales to understand which topics and assets generate meaningful commercial interest.

  • Continuously improve the journey from content → lead → sales conversation.

  • Identify additional organic campaigns and channels that can generate qualified B2B leads.

Social Media & Brand Authority

  • Take ownership of Bamboo Works' organic social media presence, with a particular focus on LinkedIn.

  • Build content that establishes Bamboo Works as an authority in global workforce solutions and our priority niches.

  • Identify opportunities to grow reach, engagement, and relevant audiences organically.

  • Test different content formats, topics, and approaches based on performance.

  • Focus on meaningful business outcomes rather than vanity metrics alone.

Website, Email & Marketing Automation

  • Review website content and identify opportunities to improve messaging, CTAs, landing pages, and conversion paths.

  • Identify content gaps based on customer questions, search demand, and commercial priorities.

  • Develop email campaigns and nurture sequences for leads and prospects.

  • Build and manage straightforward marketing automation and lead follow-up workflows using tools such as GoHighLevel.

  • Help continuously improve our website as both a marketing and sales asset.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and track meaningful KPIs across content, SEO, GEO, social media, and lead generation.

  • Monitor traffic, rankings, engagement, leads, and conversion performance.

  • Identify which content and channels are genuinely contributing to growth.

  • Regularly report on performance and recommend what we should do more, less, or differently.

  • Continuously test and improve rather than simply producing more content.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years of relevant marketing experience, ideally within B2B.

  • Strong experience developing and executing marketing strategies rather than working solely as an executor.

  • Excellent content marketing and copywriting skills, with the ability to produce authoritative, engaging English-language content.

  • Strong practical SEO knowledge and experience improving organic search performance.

  • Experience using organic content to generate leads and support business growth.

  • Experience creating B2B lead magnets, content assets, or conversion-focused resources.

  • Strong understanding of B2B customer journeys and organic demand generation.

  • Experience managing LinkedIn and other relevant social channels.

  • Ability to conduct independent market, competitor, keyword, and audience research.

  • Strong analytical skills and confidence using marketing data to guide decisions.

  • Ability to use AI tools effectively for research, ideation, production, optimization, and analysis without sacrificing human judgment or content quality.

  • Highly proactive and capable of independently taking ideas from strategy through execution.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience within staffing, recruitment, outsourcing, professional services, accounting, SaaS, or another B2B environment.

  • Understanding of GEO, AEO, AI search optimization, or how generative AI is changing organic discovery.

  • Experience with GoHighLevel or similar CRM/marketing automation platforms.

  • Experience with CMS, analytics, and common SEO tools.

  • Email marketing and nurture sequence experience.

  • Experience improving website content, landing pages, and conversion journeys.

Portfolio & Results

We're particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate measurable results from their previous work.

As part of your application, we'd love to see examples such as:

  • B2B campaigns that generated qualified leads.

  • Organic or social accounts you've successfully grown.

  • SEO improvements or rankings you've helped achieve.

  • Blogs or long-form content you've personally written.

  • Lead magnets, guides, reports, templates, or other resources you've created.

  • Content strategies that contributed to measurable business growth.

We're less interested in how much content you've produced than in understanding what you did, why you did it, and what happened as a result.

Ideal Candidate Profile

This role is ideal for someone who combines the mindset of a strategist with the ability of a hands-on marketer.

You're commercially minded and understand that marketing should ultimately create awareness, authority, and qualified business opportunities. You're an excellent writer, but you also understand SEO, distribution, funnels, analytics, and how individual marketing activities work together.

You're curious enough to deeply understand an industry rather than producing generic content. You proactively bring ideas to the table, test them, measure what happens, and continuously improve.

You also embrace AI as an everyday marketing tool—but you know that great marketing still requires strong human judgment, originality, and a genuine understanding of the customer.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first few months, we'd expect to see:

  • A clear and repeatable organic marketing strategy across our priority channels.

  • A consistent, high-quality social media presence aligned with our new positioning.

  • A structured content and blogging engine.

  • A measurable SEO and GEO strategy.

  • Increasing organic visibility for commercially relevant topics.

  • A strong content foundation within our priority niches, particularly accounting.

  • A growing library of high-quality lead magnets and marketing assets.

  • Stronger website content and conversion paths.

  • Clear marketing KPIs and regular performance reporting.

  • Increasing qualified inbound interest and stronger marketing support for our Sales team.

Ultimately, we want marketing to become a compounding asset for Bamboo Works—where every piece of content, search ranking, resource, and piece of industry knowledge contributes to stronger brand authority and future demand generation.

Recruitment Process

  1. Application & Portfolio Review

  2. Initial Interview

  3. Interview with Bamboo Works Leadership

  4. Practical Assessment (if required)

  5. Offer & Onboarding

This role reports directly to the VP, AI Portfolio & Partnerships and will partner with different stakeholders across the business.

You will work closely with CX leadership as priorities are shaped, bringing technical and operational input to inform decisions, bring technical judgment and operational context to those conversations, and then lead the work from scoping through to production and iteration. You will bring technical judgment and operational context to scoping discussions, and work with significant autonomy within agreed priorities to see initiatives through from design to production, while working as part of a broader team, not in isolation.

    The combination this role asks for is not common: someone technically confident to build and ship, with the programme management skills to run complex cross-functional work, and the communication skills to make both sides legible to each other. If that combination describes you, this is a role where you will have real ownership, real impact, and real variety.

How this role contributes to the department's and company's goals

As Remote grows and the complexity of its customer base increases, CX has to maintain quality and responsiveness without being overwhelmed by volume or operational fragmentation. Automation and AI are central to how we do that, not by replacing good judgment, but by removing friction, surfacing the right information at the right moment, and giving specialists the tools to focus on work that actually requires a human.

Beyond efficiency, this role is about empowering the CX team. The tooling and automation built here determine how well our specialists can do their jobs, how quickly customers get real resolution, and how effectively CX can absorb new products, new partners, and growing complexity. That impact is direct and measurable.

What you bring

  • A manager of one: you identify what needs doing, set your own direction, and deliver without needing to be chased. You default to action and close your own loops.
  • Strong programme management alongside your technical ability. You can scope a complex initiative, manage stakeholders across functions, communicate clearly to non-technical audiences, and see it through from start to done, not just the build, the whole thing.
  • Hands-on experience building automation and integration systems in a CX, support, or operations context. You understand what a support workflow looks like from the inside: what slows agents down, what good resolution actually means, and what tooling helps versus what just looks good in a demo.
  • Technical confidence: you can build, read, and debug code; design and work with APIs, webhooks, and integration standards including MCP; and move fast using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as part of your standard workflow. You take ownership of complex technical systems end to end, from design through to production.
  • Solid experience with low-code and no-code workflow platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, Retool, Gumloop, or similar, to design and run cross-system automations.
  • You know when automation is the right answer and when it is not. You evaluate the problem before reaching for a tool, and you are as comfortable making the case against automating something as you are building it.
  • Experience deploying AI agents or AI-assisted workflows in a production environment, including designing for failure, building in human oversight, and maintaining auditability.
  • The ability to translate between operational needs and technical constraints in both directions, clearly, without jargon, and with the right level of detail for whoever is in the room.
  • You document what you build. Not as an afterthought, as part of how you work.
  • Writes and speaks fluent English.
  • Experience working in a remote-first environment is a plus but not required.

Key Responsibilities

Automation & AI Development

  • Contribute to and lead delivery of CX automation and AI initiatives, from scoping and design through to production and ongoing iteration.
  • Build and maintain AI agents and automated workflows that improve specialist effectiveness, reduce manual handling, and increase consistency across CX operations.
  • Deploy AI capabilities responsibly: design for failure, ensure appropriate human oversight is built in, and maintain the logs and auditability expected in a customer-facing support environment.
  • Stay across developments in AI and automation tooling, surface well-reasoned recommendations for your manager and the CX leadership team to evaluate.

CX Tooling & Systems

  • Own the technical delivery of CX tooling: the integrations, applications, and automated workflows that connect the platforms CX teams depend on every day.
  • Build and maintain integrations across the CX technology stack, including Zendesk and its application framework, Remote's internal platform, REST APIs, webhooks, and emerging integration standards such as MCP, ensuring data flows correctly, triggers fire reliably, and tooling holds up under operational load.
  • As Remote's customer and partner base grows, support the CX tooling requirements that come with it: new channels, new integrations, increasing complexity.

Programme Delivery & Documentation

  • Manage complex, multi-phase delivery: own dependencies, communicate proactively, and bring initiatives across the line without needing to be chased.
  • Document everything you own. Accurate, accessible documentation is part of the definition of done, not something that happens later.
  • Identify technical debt, undocumented processes, and fragile points in the CX automation stack and address them systematically.

Data & Continuous Improvement

  • Use operational data and CX performance metrics to inform priorities and validate what is working. Build visibility into the impact of automation for CX leadership.
  • Define success metrics for each initiative, track them, and use them to make decisions about what to iterate on and what to stop.

Cross-functional Partnership

  • Work closely with CX operations and front-line teams to understand workflow pain points, validate solutions before they ship, and support adoption after they do.
  • Partner with engineering, product, and data teams across Remote to align on architecture and escalate when a problem needs more than automation to solve.
  • Communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders at all levels: operational teams, CX leadership, and cross-functional partners.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Senior Manager, CX Business Operations
  • Team: Customer Experience
  • Location: For this position we welcome everyone to apply, but we will prioritize applications from the following locations as we encourage our teams to diversify;
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Application process

  1. Interview with recruiter
  2. Interview with future manager
  3. Interview with team members (no managers present)
  4. Interview with Executive
  5. Bar Raiser Interview

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

Benefits

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

raw.title: Senior Team Lead, Paid Social
raw.excerpt: Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, and technology to make a mark on our communities - our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors.
raw.description:
Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, and technology to make a mark on our communities - our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors. We believe in relentlessly pursuing (and sharing) the truth – bringing together millions of data points from quantitative and qualitative sources to base our decisions on. Our purpose is to unlock potential for our communities mentioned above. Our vision is a world where it’s easy to do the right thing throughout those communities. If you’re ready to uplift others, challenge your ego, commit to the truth, and be better than yesterday – keep reading.
Seer is a remote first agency and Certified B-Corp with team members working across the country. If an office environment is more your style, this position can also sit in our HQ office, Philadelphia. We can only consider candidates based in the US who are able to work continental US based hours.
The Role: As a Senior Paid Social Lead, you are naturally a consultant and leader. You test before you have an opinion. When a platform ships a new feature, an algorithm shifts, or someone on the team says "this doesn't work anymore," your instinct isn't to nod along, it's to run it on Seer first and see what actually happens. You back your point of view with receipts, not vibes: links, screenshots, and firsthand results over secondhand sentiment. You're not satisfied with Seer being seen as solid at Paid Social. You want us known, publicly, as one of the best, and you're ready to set the direction that gets us there, not just execute someone else's. You've built and grown a team before, and you know that scaling a group of Paid Social SMEs takes the same rigor you'd apply to a new ad format or bidding strategy.

Role Highlights

  • Evangelize Seer's vision within Paid Social, working closely with Seer's Paid Media Leadership Team to drive excitement, adoption, and integration as we run full-steam toward being an industry leader in AI, automation, machine learning, and holistic search strategies
  • Drive full-funnel Paid Social strategy through an integrated approach, leveraging deep expertise across a variety of paid social channels (Meta, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, Reddit, and more) while collaborating closely with divisions like Creative and SEO to grow your clients' bottom line
  • Own the test, learn, and iterate mindset across the client portfolio, running tests on Seer's own accounts first before rolling recommendations out to clients, treating our media budget as the proving ground for new platforms, formats, and AI-driven workflows
  • Leverage your Paid Media expertise across other paid channels (Paid Search, Display, Programmatic) to drive an integrated approach to Paid Social strategy
  • Lead a team of 4 to 6 direct reports, setting a bar for excellence and evidence-backed thinking that your team rises to meet, and take ownership of how that team grows and develops over time
  • Drive creative innovation and synergy between divisions within Seer to help provide direction for our growing Paid Social and Creative offering
  • Oversee day-to-day campaign strategy and management for 3 to 4 accounts, implementing industry best practices and making recommendations at scale, backed by what you've actually tested
  • Develop strong frameworks for building Seer's Paid Social Book of Business within the current client portfolio and within new and developing industries and channels
  • Build strong, lasting client relationships using Seer's values as your compass, positioning your team as an extension of theirs and taking their wins and losses as your own Play a key role in growing divisional revenue through cross-selling and up-selling, working closely with our business development team to identify, qualify, and close projects
  • Create and maintain scalable processes that support our AI transformation and holistic strategy in social, driving buy-in and excitement across our Paid Social division
  • Push Seer's public reputation in Paid Social from competent to category-leading, through original points of view, case studies, and thought leadership grounded in work you've actually done

Essential Skills

  • You have led and scaled a team of 2 or more direct reports, and you've shaped how that team grows, not just how it performs day to day
  • You treat Paid as a testing discipline end to end, which means you're already testing AI tools and workflows in your own work, not waiting for someone else to prove them out first. Before you form a point of view on a channel, feature, or platform change, you've already run it on either clients or Seer's own accounts
  • You are someone who challenges the status quo and brings the team along with you to think about new ways to evolve our Paid Social program and our UVP to clients
  • You want Seer to be known publicly as one of the best in the industry at Paid Social, not just a safe, competent choice
  • You have managed Paid Social campaigns across a wide range of industries, engines, and management platforms, and you know when and where automation and machine learning can get your team's time back
  • You have experience in emerging channels like TikTok and Reddit, and in pitching full-funnel strategies that incorporate creative design, supplemental marketing channels, and measurement plans
  • You have experience partnering with leadership on strategy or account decisions that extend beyond your own book of business
  • You take a data-driven, holistic approach to Paid Social, pulling in signal from Creative, SEO, and Analytics to build smarter strategies
  • You are skilled at developing and recognizing talent, whether that's coaching up a team member who's still finding their footing or making sure a strong quarter gets seen
  • You are quick to kick up a new opportunity and run with it, making data-driven, actionable recommendations that create value for your clients
  • You have a habit of sharing what you learn, through 1:1s, Lunch 'n Learns, webinars, blogs, case studies, or speaking engagements
  • You are savvy with Excel, Google Suite, and data viz tools, and you understand data sources, data constructs, and the basics of SQL
  • You have an eye for great talent, finding it, keeping it, and growing it

30/60/90

  • First 30 Days — Learn

  • Complete division training and begin supporting clients and your team of direct reports

  • Run your first test on a Seer account and share what you found with the team

  • 60 Days — Build

  • Be fully ramped on your 3 to 4 accounts and actively developing your 4 to 6 direct reports

  • Bring a documented point of view (with receipts) to the team on a platform, format, or AI workflow you've tested

  • 90 Days — Lead

  • Operate at full capacity, owning your book of business and your team's growth independently

  • Have a visible piece of thought leadership in motion, internal or external, that reflects your tested point of view

This might not be the right role for you if

  • Time management, context-switching, and juggling multiple projects and people is genuinely difficult for you
  • You're inclined to adopt other people's takes on a platform or tactic rather than testing it yourself
  • Continued learning and innovation, including with AI, isn't something you want as a baseline expectation
  • You'd rather execute a plan than help set one for your team or the division
  • Change management is hard for you and you struggle adapting to new tools and processes

raw.title: Director of Global Strategy & Programs
raw.excerpt: COMPANY PROFILECodeAI is an education innovation nonprofit dedicated to the vision that every student in every school has the opportunity to learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and computer science (CS) as part of their core K-12 education.
raw.description:
COMPANY PROFILE

CodeAI is an education innovation nonprofit dedicated to the vision that every student in every school has the opportunity to learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and computer science (CS) as part of their core K-12 education. We increase participation in AI+CS education by reaching students of all backgrounds where they are — at their skill level, in their schools, and in ways that inspire them to keep learning, with a focus on increasing participation by young women and students from other underrepresented groups. The leading provider of K-12 AI+CS education curriculum across the globe, CodeAI also organizes the annual Hour of AI campaign, building on the legacy of the Hour of Code, which has engaged more than 15% of all students in the world!

A unifying approach in a divided world

CodeAI's global role in the K-12 computer science movement is only possible because we use a unifying approach across diverse and often divided stakeholders. At a time of increasing polarization, the idea of increasing opportunity for students unites people from across the political spectrum. CodeAI's team members, students, teachers, and supporters have diverse and diverging view points, and they are all welcome in our mission. Read more.

JOB SUMMARY

As Director of Global Strategy & Programs, you'll set the strategic direction for CodeAI's work expanding access to CS + AI learning experiences outside the U.S. You'll decide where and how Global can have the greatest impact, then build the programs, partnerships, and systems needed to get there.

You'll balance depth-market investment with breadth-market scale, translating big-picture strategy into operating models that actually work in classrooms while representing CodeAI's global work to ministries of education, partners, and media.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, you will:

Global Strategy & Impact

  • Define CodeAI's global strategy, setting the goals, KPIs, and market approaches that expand access to and adoption of CS + AI learning.
  • Own global performance, using data, market insight, and partner feedback to spot opportunities and improve impact.
  • Decide where Global can have the greatest impact, balancing deep engagement in priority markets against scalable approaches everywhere else.
  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy as a strategic leader, aligning priorities across the organization.

Programs, Markets & Partnerships

  • Build and scale global programs that help partners and ecosystems deliver CodeAI's learning experiences sustainably.
  • Design distinct strategies for breadth markets (in-market partners) and depth markets (direct investment in infrastructure and partnerships).
  • Design frameworks and partner models that bring curriculum, product, marketing, operations, and partnerships together into one coherent program.
  • Win leadership and cross-functional buy-in for global strategies, securing the resources needed to execute.
  • Adapt programs and operating models to local context while holding the line on CodeAI's mission and standards.

Team & Operational Leadership

  • Lead and grow a small Global team — setting goals, coaching, and supporting career development.
  • Manage the Global team's budget and oversee vendors and contracted partners (teacher training, localization, market implementation).
  • Build systems for consistent execution, measurement, and reporting across the partner ecosystem.

Advocacy & Organizational Alignment

  • Represent CodeAI's global work and partner ecosystem to government and ministry leaders, nonprofit and education partners, and media.
  • Turn complex global strategy and market dynamics into narratives that drive decisions across the organization.
  • Build cross-team understanding of how global insights and partnerships should inform CodeAI's broader strategy.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

We seek candidates who have:

  • 7+ years of experience driving systemic change in K-12 education worldwide, particularly in AI and Computer Science education.
  • Deep experience in nonprofit settings, partnering with ministries of education, school systems, and teacher networks to expand equitable access to CS education.
  • An entrepreneurial, autonomous operating style — able to align programs and partnerships across complex education ecosystems to hit measurable outcomes.
  • The ability to design and scale programs spanning multiple workstreams: curriculum, teacher PD, government relations, and partner enablement.
  • Comfort operating at both ends of the spectrum — presenting strategic frameworks to boards and funders, and inspiring educators and partners directly.
  • A track record building data-driven systems that measure program effectiveness and student/teacher impact at scale.
  • A reputation as a trusted mentor and collaborator who builds alignment around shared goals across diverse teams and partners.

In addition, candidates must:

  • Be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
  • Work within the continental United States
  • Pass a pre-employment background check
  • Be willing to travel a minimum of two times per year for team events

OUR CULTURAL PRINCIPLES

The way we work matters as much as the work itself. Before you apply, we invite you to take a look at our cultural principles. They reflect who we are, how we show up for each other, and what we look for in the people who join us.

OUR APPROACH TO AI IN HIRING

At CodeAI, we use AI thoughtfully and responsibly to support human-centered hiring. AI may help with administrative tasks, but every hiring decision is made by real people on our team. We welcome candidates to use AI appropriately in their job search while upholding our values of honesty and integrity throughout the process.

Read our full AI Use Policy in Hiring here.

WHAT IS THE INTERVIEW PROCESS LIKE?

Step 1: Informational Interview - learn more about the role and share your experience (30 minutes)

Step 2: Take-Home Assignment (~3 hours)

Step 3: Interviews with several members of the CodeAI team (3 hours)
Step 4: Final Interviews (2 hours)
Step 5: Reference Checks

All interviews are currently being conducted virtually via Google Meet

TO APPLY

Our team will review all applications on an ongoing basis and if we believe your qualifications would make a great fit, we'll contact you to schedule an informational interview.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS PACKAGE

The expected salary range for this position is $117,000 - $130,000. Most offers are on the lower end of the salary range and are at the company’s sole discretion based on the final candidate’s experience. This allows us to provide a fair and equitable approach to compensation when setting pay and maintaining internal pay equity.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees that includes:

  • Technology subsidy consistent with our Bring Your Own Device environment

Summary

The Clinical Policy Specialist – Itemized Bill Review is responsible for the development, enhancement, and performance of Itemized Bill Review clinical and coding solutions. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for Itemized Bill Review policies, methodologies, and audit strategies, leveraging expertise in healthcare reimbursement, facility billing, revenue integrity, coding, payment policies, and regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive knowledge of inpatient and outpatient facility billing, UB-04 claim processing, itemized bill analysis, coding guidelines, reimbursement methodologies, and payment integrity strategies. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining audit concepts, conducting clinical and coding research, analyzing claims and billing data, monitoring program performance, supporting client implementations, and ensuring content aligns with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

This position plays a critical role in identifying billing vulnerabilities, developing innovative audit strategies, improving claim selection methodologies, and maximizing recovery opportunities while ensuring accurate and defensible review outcomes.

Your role in our mission

  • Collaborate with Medical Directors, Clinical Leadership, Product, Analytics, and Innovation teams to develop clinical, coding, and Itemized Bill Review solutions that enhance audit strategies, claim selection processes, and payment integrity outcomes.
  • Design and implement audit concepts, review criteria, and reimbursement validation strategies to identify billing discrepancies, improve facility billing accuracy, support recovery opportunities, and strengthen payment integrity programs.
  • Leverage data analysis, research, and performance monitoring to develop new clinical and coding concepts, evaluate results, recommend process improvements, and optimize program effectiveness.
  • Monitor changes in clinical and coding guidelines, regulations, and reimbursement policies, updating audit rules and review methodologies to ensure compliance and program alignment.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Itemized Bill Review, facility billing practices, reimbursement methodologies, and audit standards, providing guidance to clients, leadership, and cross-functional teams.
  • Develop defensible audit rationales, clinical and coding content, training materials, and documentation while supporting special projects, client discussions, RFP activities, and ongoing program implementation.

What we're looking for

  • Associate’s Degree required, Bachelor's degree preferred (health administration, business, nursing)
  • Active, Unrestricted RN license from the United States and in the primary home residency, active compact multistate unrestricted RN license as defined by the Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC), required
  • At least one of the following coding certifications RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CCS-P, CIC, CPC, CPMA or equivalent clinical/coding credential.
  • 5+ years of experience in payment integrity, healthcare reimbursement, facility claims auditing, medical bill review, DRG validation, revenue integrity, or clinical policy development.
  • 5+ years of experience performing Itemized Bill Review or Medical Bill Review auditing facility claims.
  • 3+ years of experience with healthcare policy, Medicare guidelines and State regulation research and interpretation.
  • Extensive knowledge of Medicare and Medicaid reimbursement methodologies, hospital billing practices, UB-04 claims, coding guidelines, and revenue cycle processes.
  • Experience developing audit concepts, review criteria, policies, or payment integrity solutions.
  • Ability to research State and Federal regulations, clinical policies, coding guidelines to develop and implement policies, clinical/coding resources, and tools to support Gainwell’s Clinical Claim Review products.

What you should expect in this role

  • Location: Remote (U.S.-based)
  • Travel: Up to 10%

Job Summary:

The EDI Technical Product Manager serves as the strategic and technical owner of CareSource's EDI platform, responsible for driving the vision, roadmap, and execution of enterprise data exchange capabilities. This role combines a deep understanding of healthcare EDI standards with strong product management and technical skills to deliver scalable, reliable, and regulatory-compliant integration solutions. The EDI Technical Product Manager partners with engineering, architecture, operations, and business stakeholders to ensure EDI products support organizational objectives, reduce friction for trading partners, and improve end-to-end data quality.

Essential Functions:
  • Define and evolve the EDI product vision, strategy, and long-term roadmap in alignment with enterprise architecture, regulatory mandates, and CareSource’s operational priorities.
  • Create business cases, success metrics, and ROI analyses to guide prioritization and investment decisions.
  • Stay current on industry trends, CMS/state requirements, and interoperability standards (X12, APIs, FHIR) to shape the future-state EDI landscape.
  • Translate complex business, regulatory, and integration requirements into clear, actionable user stories and technical specifications for engineering teams.
  • Ensuring requirements encompass data mapping, validation business rules, error handling flows, and integration points across downstream systems.
  • Collaborate closely with architecture, engineering, QA, and DevOps to guide solution design, ensure technical feasibility, and support high-quality deployment.
  • Own and prioritize the EDI product backlog based on technical dependencies, stakeholder value, operational impact, and compliance needs.
  • Drive sprint planning, feature readiness, and release coordination to support predictable and transparent delivery.
  • Identify and remove impediments that impact engineering throughput or trading partner readiness.
  • Act as a bridge between technical teams, trading partners, clearing houses, and internal business units to ensure alignment and clarity of expectations.
  • Lead discovery sessions, refinement cycles, data exchange walkthroughs, and post-implementation assessments.
  • Advocate for partner usability and operational efficiency through system improvements, automation, and enhanced monitoring capabilities.
  • Analyze transaction performance, defect trends, operational SLAs, and platform telemetry to identify risks, bottlenecks, and optimization opportunities.
  • Define and track KPIs/OKRs such as transaction throughput, first-pass acceptance rate, error volume, partner onboarding speed, and system reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering to drive continuous improvement in observability, error reconciliation, and data integrity.
  • Establish and maintain comprehensive product documentation, functional requirements, user guides, and integration specifications.
  • Contribute to technical standards, EDI governance frameworks, and best practices for onboarding, testing, and release coordination.
  • Ensure solutions comply with HIPAA, state Medicaid requirements, data privacy standards, and CareSource security guidelines.
  • Perform any other job related duties as requested.

  • Skilled in software development or engineering
  • Understanding of the Healthcare industry and ecosystem including future direction. In-depth knowledge of interoperability standards relevant to the industry
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential for articulating product vision and collaborating with stakeholders
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to assess performance and identify areas for improvement
  • Ability to adapt to rapidly changing technologies and market conditions
  • A mindset geared toward innovation, continuously seeking new ways to enhance capabilities and interoperability
  • Knowledge of AI technologies, machine learning models, and ethical considerations in AI deployment

  • Certifications in core technical systems such as Edifecs, Facets, Cloud, AI, or other similar enterprise systems that CareSource invests in are preferred

Funciones principales

  • Diseño e implementación de arquitecturas cloud: diseñar sistemas escalables, resilientes y de alta disponibilidad utilizando servicios como Amazon S3, EC2, EKS, Lambda, Glue, ECS, Kinesis, CloudFormation/Terraform y Amazon RDS. Aplicar el AWS Well-Architected Framework (WAF) como marco de referencia.

  • Diseño de arquitectura de software y de datos: definir modelos de datos, bounded contexts, contratos de API y patrones de desacoplamiento (hexagonal/adapter) para sistemas de procesamiento de datos complejos, e implicarse directamente en la construcción de las piezas de mayor riesgo de diseño.

  • Optimización de costes: dimensionar y ajustar los recursos cloud para maximizar la eficiencia operativa, apoyándose en AWS Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets y AWS Trusted Advisor.

  • Seguridad y cumplimiento: definir controles de acceso, cifrado de datos y políticas de mitigación de riesgos mediante IAM, KMS, Amazon VPC, NACLs, Security Groups, Direct Connect y VPN.

  • Migración y modernización: acompañar a las organizaciones en la migración de sistemas legacy hacia la nube y en la evolución hacia arquitecturas de microservicios y serverless, mediante migración incremental con validación de equivalencia frente al sistema origen.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiencia demostrable diseñando e implementando soluciones sobre AWS(mínimo 3 años), incluyendo networking (VPC, subnets, routing), bases de datos (RDS, DynamoDB, Redshift, Aurora PostgreSQL/MySQL, e idealmente también bases de datos documentales), computación (EC2, EKS, Lambda, ECS/Fargate) y servicios de datos (Glue o Spark distribuido/EMR, Kinesis).

  • Experiencia y conocimiento en ingeniería de datos. Stack de referencia: Python (pandas, PySpark), SQL, Apache Spark/PySpark, AWS Glue, boto3, Docker; valorable experiencia con orquestadores tipo Airflow o equivalentes nativos de AWS (Step Functions, EventBridge).

  • Diseño de arquitectura de software:diseño de APIs REST/OpenAPI contract-first, versionado y compatibilidad hacia atrás de contratos. Más allá del API en sí: criterio para decidir entre monolito modular vs. microservicios según el contexto, arquitectura hexagonal/clean architecture con separación clara de capas (dominio, aplicación, infraestructura), etc.

  • Inteligencia artificial: se valora positivamente el conocimiento y experiencia en soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial y LLMs, tanto a nivel de servicios cloud (p. ej. Amazon Bedrock y Agentcore, integración de modelos de lenguaje en pipelines de datos) como en el uso de herramientas de desarrollo asistido por IA para acelerar la implementación.

  • Experiencia conDevOps yInfrastructure as Code(CloudFormation y/o Terraform).

  • Valorable contar con certificaciónAWS Solutions Architect(Associate o Professional).

  • Nivel deinglés alto (B2+ / C1), hablado y escrito.

  • Buscamos alguien conbuenas soft skills: comunicación efectiva, escucha activa, trabajo en equipo, adaptabilidad, resolución de problemas…

raw.description:
Job Summary:

The EDI Technical Product Manager serves as the strategic and technical owner of CareSource's EDI platform, responsible for driving the vision, roadmap, and execution of enterprise data exchange capabilities. This role combines a deep understanding of healthcare EDI standards with strong product management and technical skills to deliver scalable, reliable, and regulatory-compliant integration solutions. The EDI Technical Product Manager partners with engineering, architecture, operations, and business stakeholders to ensure EDI products support organizational objectives, reduce friction for trading partners, and improve end-to-end data quality.

Essential Functions:
  • Define and evolve the EDI product vision, strategy, and long-term roadmap in alignment with enterprise architecture, regulatory mandates, and CareSource’s operational priorities.
  • Create business cases, success metrics, and ROI analyses to guide prioritization and investment decisions.
  • Stay current on industry trends, CMS/state requirements, and interoperability standards (X12, APIs, FHIR) to shape the future-state EDI landscape.
  • Translate complex business, regulatory, and integration requirements into clear, actionable user stories and technical specifications for engineering teams.
  • Ensuring requirements encompass data mapping, validation business rules, error handling flows, and integration points across downstream systems.
  • Collaborate closely with architecture, engineering, QA, and DevOps to guide solution design, ensure technical feasibility, and support high-quality deployment.
  • Own and prioritize the EDI product backlog based on technical dependencies, stakeholder value, operational impact, and compliance needs.
  • Drive sprint planning, feature readiness, and release coordination to support predictable and transparent delivery.
  • Identify and remove impediments that impact engineering throughput or trading partner readiness.
  • Act as a bridge between technical teams, trading partners, clearing houses, and internal business units to ensure alignment and clarity of expectations.
  • Lead discovery sessions, refinement cycles, data exchange walkthroughs, and post-implementation assessments.
  • Advocate for partner usability and operational efficiency through system improvements, automation, and enhanced monitoring capabilities.
  • Analyze transaction performance, defect trends, operational SLAs, and platform telemetry to identify risks, bottlenecks, and optimization opportunities.
  • Define and track KPIs/OKRs such as transaction throughput, first-pass acceptance rate, error volume, partner onboarding speed, and system reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering to drive continuous improvement in observability, error reconciliation, and data integrity.
  • Establish and maintain comprehensive product documentation, functional requirements, user guides, and integration specifications.
  • Contribute to technical standards, EDI governance frameworks, and best practices for onboarding, testing, and release coordination.
  • Ensure solutions comply with HIPAA, state Medicaid requirements, data privacy standards, and CareSource security guidelines.
  • Perform any other job related duties as requested.

Education and Experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field required
  • Equivalent years of relevant work experience may be accepted in lieu of required education
  • Five (5) years of experience in product management or related field required
Competencies, Knowledge and Skills:
  • Strong understanding of EDI technologies and integration platforms
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and product development life cycles
  • Skilled in software development or engineering
  • Understanding of the Healthcare industry and ecosystem including future direction. In-depth knowledge of interoperability standards relevant to the industry
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential for articulating product vision and collaborating with stakeholders
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to assess performance and identify areas for improvement
  • Ability to adapt to rapidly changing technologies and market conditions
  • A mindset geared toward innovation, continuously seeking new ways to enhance capabilities and interoperability
  • Knowledge of AI technologies, machine learning models, and ethical considerations in AI deployment
Licensure and Certification:
  • Certifications in core technical systems such as Edifecs, Facets, Cloud, AI, or other similar enterprise systems that CareSource invests in are preferred
  • Certifications in Agile, SAFE, or in the Business or Product Owner role are preferred
Working Conditions:
  • General office environment; may be required to sit or stand for extended periods of time
  • Travel is not typically required

Compensation Range:

$94,100.00 - $164,800.00

CareSource takes into consideration a combination of a candidate’s education, training, and experience as well as the position’s scope and complexity, the discretion and latitude required for the role, and other external and internal data when establishing a salary level. In addition to base compensation, you may qualify for a bonus tied to company and individual performance. We are highly invested in every employee’s total well-being and offer a substantial and comprehensive total rewards package.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) supports Cardinal Health’s strategic objectives by nurturing and expanding relationships with existing customers across the full lifecycle of engagements: from initial onboarding through renewal and expansion. This role is focused on driving growth within current accounts, ensuring high client satisfaction, retention, and repeat business. The CSM does not carry responsibility for new customer acquisition but will partner closely with Business Development Directors by supporting relationship continuity and identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts.

North America Acquisition (New Logo) Account Executive

Reports To: Vice President, North America Acquisition (New Logo) Accounts
Location: Remote, with proximity to major airport

You’re a true enterprise hunter who knows how to break into named accounts, build conviction with executives, and close complex SaaS + services deals.

In this role, you’ll win net-new enterprise and upper mid-market customers across our highest-priority Win Zones at Accruent. You’ll run the full new-logo motion: outbound strategy, multi-threaded discovery, solution alignment, services positioning, procurement navigation, and close.

  • Industry-focused hunting: Sell into defined verticals where we have the right to win, called “Win Zones” with a clear ICP—not a “boil the ocean” territory.
  • Enterprise deal complexity: Multi-stakeholder, ROI-driven cycles with real business outcomes.
  • SaaS + services value: Sell solutions that combine software and services to drive adoption and measurable results.
  • Strong internal partnership: Supported by BDRs, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, and Services, which allows you to remain focused on creating and converting pipeline.

Key Responsibilities

Hunt and create net-new demand in priority Win Zones

  • Build an account plan and outbound motion for enterprise/upper mid-market prospects in target verticals (e.g., Utilities, Manufacturing, Electronics, Mining).
  • Pipeline generated via multi-channel prospecting (calls, email, social, events) and convert inbound interest into qualified opportunities.
  • Multi-thread into accounts by mapping stakeholders (economic buyer, champion, IT/security, procurement, operations).

Run executive-level discovery and solution selling (SaaS + services)

  • Lead consultative discoveries to uncover business drivers, quantify value, and define success metrics (ROI, risk, compliance, productivity, customer experience).
  • Build compelling, industry-relevant narratives aligned to buyer workflows and use cases.
  • Position software and professional services to reduce implementation risk and accelerate time-to-value.

Drive complex deal execution and close

  • Own the full cycle from first meeting to signature and kickoff.
  • Lead rigorous deal strategy: mutual action plans, stakeholder maps, executive alignment, and clear next steps.
  • Navigate security reviews, legal, and procurement; negotiate commercials while protecting value and timelines.
  • Ensure a seamless handoff to Customer Success and Professional Services post-sale.

Must-Have Experience

  • 5+ years of successful enterprise B2B SaaS sales experience with a strong emphasis on new logo acquisition.
  • Demonstrated success closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals (including procurement/legal/security steps).
  • Experience selling solutions that include services/implementation (or strong ability to position/attach services).
  • Strong outbound and territory-planning capability (you can build pipeline, not just work it).
  • Proficiency with CRM and disciplined forecast/pipeline management (Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics, etc.).

Highly Preferred Experience

  • Direct experience selling into Asset-heavy industries (e.g., Utilities, Manufacturing, Processing, Electronics, Mining).
  • Executive presence with VP/C-level stakeholders and cross-functional buying groups.
  • Track record of consistent attainment in enterprise hunting roles (president’s club, top-performer, etc.).

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

About Accruent

Personal development and becoming the best you is all about growth and exploring new skills and opportunities – both in and out of the office. At Accruent, we call this Grow Without Limits, and we’re proud to offer each of our employees the resources, coaching and support necessary to achieve Growth Without Limits in their personal and professional lives. Explore where the path takes you.

Accruent is a leading provider of solutions for unifying the built environment —spanning real estate, physical and digital assets, and the integrated technology systems that connect and control them. Accruent continues to set new expectations for how organizations can use data to transform how they manage their facilities and assets. With U.S. headquarters in Austin, Texas, Accruent serves over 5,000 customers in a wide range of industries in more than 100 countries worldwide.

THE BIGGEST NAME IN HOME. THE BOLDEST TEAM IN E-COMMERCE.

Ashley Digital is the e-commerce engine behind Ashley Furniture Industries — one of the most recognized home brands in the world. As the world's largest manufacturer of home furnishings and the largest furniture store brand in North America, Ashley is in a category unto itself. Our team sits at the intersection of world-class retail and digital innovation, driving the e-commerce experience for millions of customers across every platform and touchpoint. If you’ve shopped online for a mattress in the last decade, there’s a good chance you’ve already experienced our award-winning Nectar Sleep and DreamCloud. We're a fast-moving, highly collaborative team operating at a transformational moment, and we're charged with shaping how people discover, explore, and buy home furnishings. Our expertise spans data science, performance marketing, product, and creative, and our work reaches millions of customers every day. It's a rare combination: the energy of a tech company, the stability of an industry leader, and the opportunity to build something truly significant. If you're energized by transformation, collaboration, and meaningful impact at scale, Ashley Digital is where ambition meets opportunity.

To be considered for this remote opportunity, you must reside and be authorized to work within the United States.

About the role:

Ashley Digital is looking for a Senior Copywriter to join our growing Creative team. If you’ve got big ideas, a smart writing style, and an editorial eye, then we’d love to hear from you. In this role, you will own the creative copywriting process from beginning to end and have full ownership of editing all copy and ultimately, the end product. Tight organization skills, and the ability to have big ideas and execute them creatively, will enable our ideal candidate to grow and develop in this new and exciting role. In this role, you will collaborate and support Ashley Digital’s creative team and work towards the evolution of our brand voice across multiple brands through product launches, digital product, marketing channels, physical experiences, packaging, and more. The ideal candidate will be highly creative and have a proven track record of using their imagination to create original content.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Own the creative copywriting process from beginning to end, with minimal input from others, including all editing and owning the end product
  • Use imagination to create original content
  • Write clear, creative copy for web content, digital ads, promotional materials, retail signage, and other marketing collateral
  • Write and edit long-form blog posts and articles that support SEO, organic traffic, and brand authority goals
  • Ensure clear, and recognizable tone of voice across multiple distinct contemporary customer-facing brands
  • Maintain a consistent editorial voice across blog content while flexing tone per brand
  • Work across Retail, Amazon and Big Box to support retail marketing efforts
  • Support A/B Testing & Data Driven Copy with CRM, Growth and Creative Teams
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders to ensure consistent brand messaging, voice, and tone across all communication channels and products
  • Be strategically minded, providing a range of options for testing themes and positioning for various products and customers
  • Ability to apply sound, independent judgment and discretion on matters of substantial importance to the company in performing duties, resolving complex problems, and interpreting policies and regulations
  • Be self-motivated and comfortable working in a dynamic environment with tight deadlines

The responsibilities described above are not exhaustive. You may be asked, from time to time and as reasonably required by business needs, to perform other duties consistent with your skills and role, including work for or on behalf of our related entities. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment and may be modified at any time, subject to applicable law.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years experience in a professional writing role
  • Experience owning copywriting process from beginning to end, with minimal oversight
  • Experience working in ecommerce, strongly preferred
  • Experience with A/B Testing and Data Driven Copy
  • Familiarity with AI Tools and how to best leverage them
  • A strong, diverse writing portfolio
  • Strong editorial judgment and writing ability
  • Ability to balance multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize your workload
  • Capable of working independently and as part of a team
  • Familiar with entrepreneurial and tech-driven creative environments
  • Experience working with AI agentic tools
  • Willing and able to attend off-site meeting bi-annually

  • Health, Vision & Dental Insurance
  • HSA company contributions
  • 401K with company match component
  • Take what you need Paid Time Off
  • Wellness benefits
  • WFH office and cell phone/internet stipend
  • A FREE MATTRESS plus an awesome Friends and Family discount!

At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.

With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work.

At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.

Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.

Position Summary:

As a Senior Product Manager at PointClickCare, you will own and drive the AI product roadmap for Revenue Cycle Management, starting with Billing Advisor, our AI-powered platform that identifies potential billable events for skilled nursing and senior living facilities, and extending to the next generation of AI advisors across pre-billing validation, collections, and claims workflows.

This is not a greenfield role. You are taking ownership of a product that is live with customers and heading into general availability. You will work in a complex, high-stakes domain where your product outputs directly affect whether facilities get paid and whether claims are denied. You need to be equally fluent in AI product behavior and billing workflows.

You contribute to the vision and strategy of your product area, define and own roadmaps, and drive execution and delivery of compelling value to users and customers. To succeed in this role, you combine product management experience in AI or ML-powered products with a working understanding of how AI recommendations translate into real operational outcomes for billing and RCM teams. You bring a collaborative approach to leadership, a track record of shipping AI products to production customers, and the credibility to earn the trust of both engineering teams and clinical-financial end users.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the full product lifecycle for one or more RCM AI Products from 0-1, GA launch, and through growth. This includes managing active customers, defining adoption metrics, tracking recommendation utilization, and driving expansion.
  • Define and own the roadmap, prioritizing opportunities across billing, claims, collections, and pre-billing workflows where AI can reduce denials, surface missed revenue, and reduce manual effort.
  • Translate AI model outputs, confidence thresholds, and recommendation accuracy tradeoffs into product decisions and customer-facing feature design.
  • Define success metrics for AI products that go beyond traditional SaaS KPIs, including recommendation adoption rate, billing event capture rate, and measurable revenue impact per customer.
  • Partner with advanced technology, data science, engineering teams, and other cross-functional teams to evaluate model performance, define customer feedback loops, and close the gap between AI output quality and customer trust and adoption.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative techniques to understand current and future customer needs, including direct engagement with billing managers, RCM directors, and facility operators.
  • Understand company strategy and contribute to the multi-year RCM AI roadmap, identifying the sequence of AI advisors that maximize customer value and PointClickCare's competitive differentiation.
  • Prioritize product investments and trade-offs using data-driven analysis and good judgment to build compelling business cases and quantify return on investment.
  • Engage with UX, Engineering, Technical Writers, and other product managers using agile processes and Design Thinking to ensure concepts are valuable and feasible.
  • Work with Sales, Marketing, Professional Services, and Customer Success to drive successful product launches, beta programs, and customer adoption of AI capabilities.
  • Participate in industry events and lead customer-facing and partner-facing engagements as a product expert.
  • Understand the competitive landscape for AI in RCM and healthcare billing.
  • Inspire, energize, and motivate cross-functional teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Healthcare technology, computer science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of software product management experience, with at least 2 years as the primary product owner of an AI or ML-powered product shipped to production customers.
  • Healthcare billing, revenue cycle management, or claims experience is required. Candidates without working knowledge of RCM workflows, payer operations, or medical billing will not be competitive for this role.
  • Demonstrated track record of managing products through beta programs and into general availability, including customer onboarding, adoption tracking, and post-launch iteration.
  • Experience defining success metrics and feedback loops for AI products, including recommendation adoption, model performance monitoring, and customer trust signals.
  • Ability to work at the intersection of domain expertise and AI product design, translating billing workflow knowledge into AI feature requirements and vice versa.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills with internal and external stakeholders, including the ability to explain AI behavior and limitations to non-technical customers and executives.
  • Solid understanding of agile practices and experience working with cross-functional teams including data science and ML engineering.
  • Experience managing SaaS products.
